title: Welcome
how: Join for the first time.

title: Group Member
description: You're one with the cool kids now!
how: Join the LSPLASH group (and get a free revive)!

title: Buddy System
how: Play a run with a friend.

title: Back From The Dead
how: Revive yourself.

title: In Plain Sight
description: Quick, behind that conveniently shaped lamp!
how: Hide from an entity by staying out of sight.
references: Achievement's description is a reference to one of Sans' lines from Undertale.

title: One Of Many
how: Encounter your first death.

title: Picking Flowers
how: Have Grampy create a Lotus for you.
tutorial: Get 8 Lotus Petals found throughout The Outdoors and bring them to Grampy in The Mill.

title: Rebirth
how: Become reborn through a Lotus.
tutorial: Die and use your Lotus.

title: Interconnected
how: Preserve an item in a Rift.
tutorial: Find a Mid-Run Rift or find a Rift in the start or end of each main floor and store a major item there.

title: Lost In Translation
description: That is NOT what I put in there.
how: Transform an item in a Rift.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to put a Candle/Smoothie/Tip Jar to transform it to a Moonlight Candle/Moonlight Float/Rift Jar which grants you the achievement.

title: Herb Of Viridis
description: My heart is beating faster than before...
how: Find and use a green herb.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need a Skeleton Key, get to the Infirmary's subroom, find skull-locked door, unlock it and use Green Herb.

title: Expert Technician
description: I'm the one for the job.
how: Complete the Hotel's breaker puzzle in under a minute.

title: Whoever Smelt It
how: Survive a Firedamp leak.

title: Trespassing
how: Escape the Nest.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to activate all anchors in The Nest (Door 0150) in The Mines and escape.

title: Running Track
description: Cart Ride From Seek (For Free Knobs)
how: Escape Seek in the Mines.
references: Achievement's description is a reference to old Roblox cart ride games, often named 'Cart Ride into _____', and some other old Roblox games having 'for Free Robux' near the end of the title.

title: Down The Drain
how: Beat Seek in The Dam.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to rotate all the Valves in The Dam (Door 0200) in The Mines and escape to The Woods.
references: Achievement's icon might be a reference to one of the scenes in Terminator where he shows a thumbs up while drowning in lava, or an elimination scene in the Polus map from Among Us (which seems to also reference the specific Terminator scene).

title: Welcome Back
how: Join another day.

title: Betrayal
how: Steal a hiding spot from someone right before they die.

title: Ten Of Many
how: Encounter your tenth death.

title: Hundred Of Many
how: Encounter your hundredth death.

title: Feed the Birds
description: They seem to have a liking on you now...
how: Feed a Caw Bread!
references: Achievement's description is a reference to the video 'brother may I have some oats' where the second pig says: 'I believe they have taken a liking to me.'

title: Unpatched Dupe Glitch
how: Use a scanner to scan and print an item.

title: Quick Purchase
description: They're out of my favorite soda!
how: Use some loose change to purchase a Shakelight.

title: Patience
how: Walk through the entire queue line in the Archives.

title: Mission Successful
description: These things have never dried my hands.
how: Flush a Toilet, turn on a Sink, and use an Air Dryer in succession.

title: Paperclip Challenge
description: Think I can buy a house with this?
how: Trade with the hooded figure in The Stairwell.

title: Rage Room
how: Successfully disable Noise.

title: Fried Mushrooms
how: Use a Fire Alarm to incinerate Meld.

title: REDACTED
how: Watch, and create a new entity.
tutorial: To get this badge, you must go to S-50 in The Archives. From there, simply turn right from the elevator, and keep going until your screen gets blurry. There, you must turn left and open Ransom’s laptop, click the (S) icon in the bottom right, and eject the disc. Take the disc to The Stairwell and insert it into Noise’s TV.

title: Grindset
description: So we're gonna go and do at least ten thousand.
how: Grind Salvage into Scrap.
tutorial: Place a heavy item found inside the stairwell into a Depot found in the stairwell.

title: Garage Sale
how: Open a garage with a Garage Key.
tutorial: Buy a key from the Stairwell pre-run shop, and open a use the key to open a garage

title: Clay World
description: It was a little overdone anyway.
how: Scrap a Ceramic Stem.
tutorial: Open the lockers inside the Stairwell, and make sure to get Stem on ur back, then go to the fire alarm and make sure to keep Stem outside of the fire alarm then burn it after that take Stem and use him in the Depot that you will find probably around.

title: Dust To Dust
how: Obtain Stardust from a Scrapper.
tutorial: Get any starlight item and put it on the depot to get a Stardust.

title: Second Wind
how: Survive damage that would normally be lethal to you.
tutorial: Go to The Backdoor, find a Vial of Starlight and use it to tank a hit from Blitz.

title: QA Tester
description: Get back to work! I said get back to work!
how: Test stuff.

title: Content Creator
how: Be part of the DOORS Content Creator program. <3

title: Out Of My Way
how: Successfully survive Rush.
references: Achievement's description references this moment from the Midnight Cowboy.

title: You Can Run
description: But you can't um... um... uhh...
how: Successfully run from Seek.
tutorial: To get this badge, you have to get through the 5 rooms in the Seek chase.

title: I See You
how: Dodge Screech's attack.

title: Wrong Room
how: Get duped by Dupe.

title: Look At Me
description: Last chance to look at me.
how: Survive the Eyes.
references: Achievement's description is a reference to a line spoken by Gustavo Fring in a scene between him and rival Hector Salamanca from a Breaking Bad episode titled 'Face Off'.

title: Eviction Notice
how: Get pushed out of a hiding spot by Hide.

title: Dead Of Night
how: Survive Dread.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to wait in one room for Dread entity to come by waiting for one hour (staying in place), or by waiting for 10 minutes (constantly moving around). After that, you need to exit the room before Dread kills you.

title: Rebound
how: Survive Ambush.
references: Achievement's description references the 'Coming back for seconds' idiom that is used to describe returning for another serving of food, usually because the first was enjoyed.

title: Two Steps Forward
how: Survive Halt.

title: Playtime
how: Give Sally a new toy.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to encounter Sally and give her any item which is not a crucifix.
references: Achievement's description probably references Playtime's phrase from the Baldi’s Basics in Education and Learning videogame.

title: I Don't Believe My Eyes
description: Dude, I swear there were like... ten million of them!
how: Survive a swarm of Gloombats.
references: Achievement's description and name reference the song Fireflies by Owl City, referencing the lyrics 'You would not believe your eyes, if ten million fireflies'.

title: Just A Prank
description: It was just a prank, bro!
how: Survive Giggle.

title: Helping Hand
description: You got a little something right... there.
how: Knock Giggle off of another player's face.

title: Trickshot
how: Whack a Giggle and stun it with a Glowstick.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to encounter Giggle and throw a Glowstick at him.
references: Achievement is a reference to the SpongeBob episode 'Krusty Krab Training Video', in which a brick is thrown at a fish who repeatedly says 'Hooplah!'

title: Trade Offer
how: Barter with Louie.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to encounter Louie in The Mines and give him any item by throwing it near his rat hole.

title: Sshh!
description: Careful not to make a sound!
how: Escape from the Library in the Hotel.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to collect all books in The Library (Door 0050) in The Hotel and unlock the padlock's code near end of the room.
references: Achievement's description references this song from the LazyTown.

title: Supporting Small Businesses
how: Purchase an item from Jeff.
references: Achievement's description may be a reference to Apu Nahasapeemapetilon's 'Thank, you come again.' Catchphrase from The Simpsons.

title: Pls Donate
description: Now I can go to college!
how: Fill Jeff's tip jar.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to put 100 Gold (Gold) in tip jar in Jeff Shop.
references: Achievement is a reference to another Roblox game of the same name and its description is a reference to the game UNDERTALE, where the protagonist is able to pay to vendor Temmie's college (referred to as 'cool leg' or 'colleg' by Temmie).

title: It Stares Back
how: Encounter the Void.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to play a run with at least another player and encounter the Void by one player staying in one room and another going to the next rooms until another player gets teleported by the Void.

title: Meet Timothy
how: Encounter Timothy while looting.
references: Achievement's icon is a reference to a joke between the developers and pre-release testers, where it was commonly requested that any drawers containing Timothy would be covered with webs, although this request always was declined and its description is a potential reference to an action in The Henry Stickmin Collection's 4th 'episode', Infiltrating the Airship, where during the Government Supported Private Investigator route, Henry attempts to spook a clan member with a tiny spider on a stick, but instead to scream or being scared and running, the clan member greeting it warmly, saying 'Oh, hello Mr. Spider.' before Henry hitting him in the head with the stick being the member dazed and knocked out..

title: Error
how: Encounter the Glitch.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to encounter Glitch by either get out of the map and fall into the void (not the entity)/having generation glitch, or by doing the same thing when encountering the Void, which is playing a subfloor run with at least another player and one player staying in one room and another going to the next rooms until another player gets teleported by Glitch, then teleported player will get the badge.

title: Meet Jack
how: Encounter Jack.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to encounter Jack by hiding in wardrobes/toolsheds (The Hotel) or lockers/toolsheds (The Mines) having a 1 200 (0.5%) chance of encounter, or by opening an entrance, having a 1 2000 (0.05%) chance.

title: Trial and Error
description: I... I think I'm seeing things.
how: Encounter and survive an activated Glitch Fragment.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to find a Glitch Fragment while looting/finding it, picking it up and surviving the glitched entity that appears. You can increase the change of Glitch Fragment spawning by doing the same thing when encountering the Void, which is playing a run, but in a subfloor with at least another player. One player needs to stay in one room and another going to the next rooms until another player gets teleported by Glitch, then you repeat (Best subfloor for this is The Rooms before room A-0060).

title: Witness Protection
description: I swear I didn't see anything! I swear!
how: Resist looking at Alma.

title: Limitless Paper
how: Successfully survive Scribbles.

title: Crowd Watching
description: Good thing I wasn't standing over there.
how: Successfully survive a stampede of Drones.

title: Perfect Memory
description: I can remember plenty of things.
how: Successfully survive the Forget-Me-Nots.

title: Carpet Burn
how: Successfully survive Bash.

title: Now Served
how: Successfully survive the Teller.
tutorial: To get this achievement, you need to give the Teller your Waiting Ticket when it is your turn (can be checked by looking at a Line Monitor or at Teller's Monitor) or alternatively waiting for it to attack you and successfully surviving.

title: Shock Hazard
how: Successfully survive a Currents hazard.

title: Fih Are Friends
how: Feed the Fih.
tutorial: To get this achievement, you need to find Fih Food (which only spawn in rooms with a Fih Aquarium) and interact with a Fih Aquarium while holding it.

title: Firewall
how: Successfully avoid or disable Ransom.
tutorial: Don't move when Ransom attacks you. If you moved, collect 500 gold. More gold will spawn while being Ransom-hacked.

title: Most Valuable Employee
description: I hope I get a promotion!
how: Successfully organize the Mail Room.

title: It's Still You
how: Stare at your reflection for too long.
references: Achievement's name and description is a reference to the line from UNDERTALE 'Despite everything, it's still you.' which is shown when interacting with a mirror near the end of the game.

title: Smashing Deal
how: Bargain with Portrait.
tutorial: To get this achievement, you need to hold an item in front of Portrait and interact with it in Portrait's hand.

title: Who Am I?
description: Of course I remember my own name...
how: Try to remember.

title: Paparazzi
description: I didn't realize someone was watching me.
how: Scare off a large spectator.

title: Bubble Popping
how: Pop a Stem by throwing it.

title: Hello Walker
how: Meet the strange, hooded creature in the Stairwell.

title: Conga Line
how: Be followed by 3 instances of Noise at once.

title: A Bone To Pick
how: Open a Skull Lock with a Skeleton Key.

title: Improvise
how: Shove a Lockpick in a Generator and call it a day.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to use a Lockpick on a Generator instead of using fuse.

title: You Finally Turn Green
how: Drink a Gween Soda and finally turn green.
tutorial: To get this badge, you must find Louie in The Mines and trade any of the items in the item pool below until he gives you the Gween Soda, and when you obtain the Gween Soda, drink it.
references: Achievement's name is a reference to the Smiling Friends episode named 'Pim Finally Turns Green'.

title: D'oh!
how: Eat a Donut.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to find a Skeleton Key and the Rift Cafe Subroom in The Hotel, in that room, you can find a Donut and eat it.
references: The achievement is a reference to the D'oh! catchphrase said by [Homer Simpson], a protagonist of animated sitcom, [The Simpsons].

title: Enlightened
how: Have a full hotbar of light sources.

title: Girl Dinner
how: Have a full hotbar of edible items.

title: Pizza Time
how: Have a full hotbar of Pizza.

title: Bad Luck
how: Beckon Portrait with a Pocket Mirror.

title: Gold Standard
how: Find and use a Honey Pot.

title: Super-Size Me
how: Obtain a Jug of Starlight.
tutorial: To get this badge, to to The Stairwell. You must collect 75 Scrap from grinding items in the Depot. Take the scrap to Cobbler, and he will give you 750 coins in exchange. Then, buy a Starlight Jug.
references: This badge's name is a reference to the movie Super Size Me.

title: Plug & Play
description: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
how: Install any module into your scanner.
tutorial: Buy a scanner for 500 coins from Cobbler's shop, and find a module, or take it from Cobbler.

title: Emancipation Customization
description: Four doors and seven knobs ago...
how: Place a peculiar hat on a distinguished individual.

title: Flash Point
how: Successfully light a Flare in under a second.

title: Rock Bottom
how: Escape The Hotel.

title: Detour
how: Enter a subfloor. Receive their acknowledgment.

title: Around Back
how: Enter The Backdoor.

title: Other Way Around
how: Escape The Backdoor.
references: Achievement's description references a scene in The Incredibles where Mr. Incredible says 'Yeah, I've got time.'

title: See You Soon
how: Escape The Mines.

title: Touched Grass
how: Enter The Outdoors through The Hotel.

title: Down The Water Spout
description: I'm more of an indoors person.
how: Escape The Outdoors.

title: Forgotten Memories
description: Something about this place feels like it should mean something to me.
how: Enter The Archives.

title: Emergency Exit
description: I think I'll call it here.
how: Escape The Archives using an Emergency Exit.

title: Z-50
how: Escape The Archives at Z-50.

title: Going Down
description: I don't think I'm supposed to see this...
how: Enter The Stairwell.

title: Going Up
how: Escape The Stairwell.

title: Stair Master
how: Loop The Stairwell.

title: Evil Be Gone
how: Use a Crucifix successfully.

title: Stay Out Of My Way
how: Use a Crucifix against Rush.
references: Achievement's description references this meme:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FNHSiPFtvA (!!WARNING: PROFANITY/SWEAR WORDS!!)

title: Unbound
how: Use a Crucifix against Ambush.

title: Take A Breather
how: Use a Crucifix against Seek.
references: Achievement's icon references this meme(https://i.imgflip.com/6pfzsx.png) of a guy sitting in a chair.

title: All Figured Out
description: I figured that wouldn't work for long...
how: Use a Crucifix against Figure.
references: Achievement's icon is a reference to this image(https://knowyourmeme.com/photos/2366096-my-reaction-to-that-information)

title: You Can't See Me
description: Stop staring at me with them big ol' eyes!
how: Use a Crucifix against the Eyes.

title: I Hate You
description: Could you not be yourself for five minutes?!
how: Use a Crucifix against Screech.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to not look at Screech when he appears and wait for it to attack you while holding a Crucifix.
references: Achievement's description references this moment from the Shrek movie.

title: Two Steps Ahead
description: I don't feel like dealing with you.
how: Use a Crucifix against Halt.
references: Achievement's name probably references this memephrase said by Nikocado Avocado Mukbanger.

title: Outwitted
how: Use a Crucifix against Dupe.

title: It's Not My Time
how: Use a Crucifix against Dread.
tutorial: Wait in one room for Dread (one hour or 10 minutes moving), then use crucifix on him.

title: Bug Zapper
how: ...'Use' a Crucifix against Timothy.

title: Lost In The Dark
how: Use a Crucifix against the Void.
references: Achievement's description references a vine made by CalebCity.

title: Under New Management
how: Use a Crucifix against Hide.
references: Achievement's name may be a reference to the scene in Megamind where the character Titan says 'I wouldn't say freed, more like under new management.'' or to Jesse from Breaking Bad informing his parents that he just bought their house.

title: Red Mist
how: Use a Crucifix against A-60.

title: Grin Reaper
how: Use a Crucifix against A-120.

title: Red Light
how: Use a Crucifix against Blitz.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to activate the Blitz, Oh modifier and use Crucifix on Blitz. This is because the Crucifix won't work in The Backdoor.

title: Lookman No Looking
how: Use a Crucifix against Lookman.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to activate the Look, Man modifier and use Crucifix on Lookman. This is because the Crucifix won't work in The Backdoor.
references: Achievement is a reference to the phrase 'Swiper no swiping!' from the TV show Dora the Explorer. This extends to its description.

title: Time Out
how: Use a Crucifix against Haste.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to activate the Make Haste modifier and use Crucifix on Haste. This is because the Crucifix won't work in The Backdoor.
references: Description references this meme(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lyc5ad8MP7E)

title: Bug Bomb
how: Use a Crucifix against a swarm of Gloombats.
references: Achievement's description references a children's song, as the 'splat, goes the gloombat!' Is a reference to the song 'Pop, goes the weasel'.

title: Not Funny
how: Use a Crucifix against Giggle.

title: The Bigger They Are
how: Use a Crucifix against Grumble.
references: Both name and description references 'The bigger they are, the harder they fall' idiom.

title: Queen's Gambit
how: Use a Crucifix against Queen Grumble.
references: Achievement's description references the oldest most popular chess openings for white called the Queen's Gambit

title: Scammed
how: Use a Crucifix against Louie.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to give Louie a Crucifix by throwing an item near his rat hole.
references: Achievement's description references a popular meme of an Indian Scammers getting Scammed.

title: Playtime's Over
description: I don't want to play with you anymore.
how: Use a Crucifix against Sally.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to encounter Sally in The Hotel and give her a Crucifix by throwing an item on the floor or by holding a Crucifix when she jumping on you when she gets close.
references: Achievement's description references this meme from the Toy Story 2.

title: Annihilation
how: Banish Portrait with a Crucifix.

title: Not Five Stars
how: Escape The Hotel with at least a 50% bonus using Modifiers.

title: Hotel Hell
description: This is the worst hotel I've ever stayed at.
how: Escape The Hotel with at least a 150% bonus using Modifiers.

title: Rocky Road
description: I think I'm good with vanilla.
how: Escape The Mines with at least a 50% bonus using Modifiers.
references: Both the name and the description have 2 meanings, the first being 'Rocky Road' - something being rocky implies the challenge was difficult, 'I think I'm good with vanilla' - vanilla in this context means 'without modifiers'. The second meaning being 'Rocky Road' - Rocky Road ice cream (chocolate), 'I think I'm good with vanilla' - Vanilla ice cream.

title: A Hard Place
how: Escape The Mines with at least a 150% bonus using Modifiers.
references: Both the name and the description are most likely a reference to the phrase 'between a rock and a hard place' which is an idiom that describes being in a difficult situation with no good options, forcing a choice between two equally unpleasant or undesirable alternatives.

title: Star Employee
description: Do you know how long it took me to get that?
how: Successfully organize the Mail Room after giving Honcho a wrong item.

title: Storage Wars
description: Three thousand is the best I can do.
how: Bargain 3000 Gold from the hooded figure in The Stairwell.

title: Winner
how: Win a round of Battle Mode in 1st place.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to win in 1st place in a Battle Mode round with at least a player in your round.

title: Winner Winner
description: You're a loser who sits and cries!
how: Win 10 rounds of Battle Mode.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to win in 1st place in a Battle Mode rounds with at least a player in each round 10 total.

title: In Plain Sight 2
description: Smile, your death will be on camera.
how: Win a round of Battle Mode while never hiding at all.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to win in 1st place in a Battle Mode round with at least a player in your round while never Hiding (Hiding Boxes also count as hiding).
references: Old achievement's description was a reference to 'We Didn’t Playtest To Make Sure This Was Possible', a Pressure badge. Achievement's name might be a reference to In Plain Sight 2, due to sharing the names, and is a callback to 'In Plain Sight' achievement.

title: Pointers
how: Gain 2500 points in one Battle Mode round.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to get at least 2500 points in one Battle Mode round.

title: High Roller
how: Gain 5000 points in one Battle Mode round.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to get at least 5000 points in one Battle Mode round.

title: A Triple
how: Eliminate 3 other players in a BATTLE Mode. Assists count.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to kill/assist in a death of at least 3 other players in one Battle Mode round.
references: Achievement's name and description are a reference to the 2010 meme 'Oh Baby, A Triple.'

title: Party Wipe
how: Eliminate 7 players in a BATTLE Mode round. Assists count.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to kill/assist in a death of at least 7 other players in one Battle Mode round.
references: Achievement's description references 20v1 meme.

title: Finders Keepers
how: Eliminate a player in one BATTLE Mode round by stealing a nearby hiding spot.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to do the same thing when getting the 'Betrayal' badge (Steal a hiding spot from someone right before they die) but in a Battle Mode round.
references: Achievement's description could be a reference to 'Mine Mine Mine' meme from Finding Nemo.

title: The One Who Dealt It
how: Eliminate a player by triggering Firedamp in one BATTLE Mode round.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to use a lighter in a room with a Firedamp when at least one another player is in it in a Battle Mode round.
references: Achievement's description is most likely a reference to the Overwatch cinematic 'Junkertown: The Plan'

title: Ring Out
how: Fling a player out of bounds with Boxing Gloves in one BATTLE Mode round.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to use Boxing Gloves on another player and make them go out of bounds (AKA knock them into the void/place that will teleport player back and take some damage) in a Battle Mode round.

title: Potassium Power
how: Have at least two players slip on your Nanner Peel in a BATTLE Mode round.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to eat a Nanner to get a Nanner Peel. Then you need to throw it on the floor and make at least 2 players slip on it in one Battle Mode round.
references: Both name and description reference lines of Queen from Deltarune.

title: Battler
how: Eliminate 100 players in total in Battle Mode.
tutorial: To get this badge, you need to kill at least 100 players in total in Battle Mode.

title: MACHINE LEARNING
how: Win any Daily Run. Retries count.
references: Achievement's description references one of the Voice's lines from Deltarune.

title: CLEAN RUN
how: Win any Daily Run on your first attempt.
references: Achievement's description references one of the Voice's lines from Deltarune.

title: PARALLEL PROCESSING
how: Win any Daily Run with other players. Retries count.

title: LOW LATENCY
how: Win any Daily Run in under 5 minutes. Retries count.

title: UPTIME
how: Keep up a Daily Streak for 7 days.
references: Achievement's description might reference to this meme of indian scammer screaming 'DO NOT REDEEM'.

title: Everything Everywhere All At Once
how: Successfully escape The Hotel in the CHAOS Vision. If using livestream integration, requires at least 3 voters each poll.
references: Achievement's name is a direct reference to the movie with the same name.

title: Truer Tower Hero
how: Defeat Bramble on Hard Mode in Tower Heroes × DOORS event.

title: We Out Here
how: Complete The Outdoors story quest in Tower Heroes × DOORS event.

title: Tower Hero
how: Play the Tower Heroes × DOORS event and complete El Goblino's Quest.

title: True Tower Hero
how: Complete The Library on Hard in Tower Heroes × DOORS event.
references: Achievement's description references Tower Heroes currency 'mana.'

title: Hotel Adventurer
description: Who needs a crucifix when you have towers!
how: Complete The Hotel in Adventure Mode in Tower Heroes × DOORS event.

title: Void Buster
description: I ain't afraid of no Void!
how: Defeat the Void in Tower Heroes × DOORS event.
references: Both achievement's name and description is a reference to the song 'Ghostbusters' by Ray Parker Jr.

title: You're It
how: Play one round in untitled tag game in the Courtyard map.

title: CERTIFIED RUSH FAN
how: Beat RUSH MODE!! (community map) by developer ItsThump.

title: Trick Or Treat!
description: Give me something good to eat!
how: Knock on 30 treater doors in Trick Or Treat 2025 event.

title: Far From Home
description: I think we should head back now.
how: Reach Room 50 in Trick Or Treat 2025 event.

title: Good Haul
how: Purchase all store items with Candy in Trick Or Treat 2025.

title: Sugar Rush
how: Eat 100 Candy during Trick Or Treat 2024 event.

title: Sugar Crash
description: Maybe I've had too much... What do you think?
how: Eat 500 Candy during Trick Or Treat 2024 event.
references: Achievement's description could be a reference to the Gravity Falls episode, The Inconveniencing. Mabel Pines, after eating too much of the sugar from Smile Dip, starts hallucinating and says 'Maybe I've had too much. What do you think?'

title: Silent Night
how: Complete the Cringle's Workshop Vision (2025 holiday event).
references: Achievement's name might be a reference to the achievement of the same name from untitled tag game.

title: Holiday Spirit
description: The most wonderful time of the year!
how: Gift anything from the store with Robux during the 2025 holidays.
references: Achievement's description references the 'It's The Most Wonderful Time Of The Year' song by Andy Williams.

title: [Bloxfest] Double Feature
